title: CurationDecision record request
description: The body of POST /api/v1/harvest-candidates/{harvest_candidate_id}/decision, reserved by MOS-API-112 and registered in table 10.2-B row R3 against the permission curation_decision.record. Chapter 17 owns the entity (MOS-TRAIN-080, and MOS-TRAIN-204 for what reason_code may never mean); the columns are 0011_curation.up.sql's curation_decisions. candidate_id is the path parameter and is NOT a body member -- two places to name the candidate is one place to disagree. decided_by is NOT a member: MOS-TRAIN-080 requires a named human and the named human is the authenticated principal, never a value the caller supplies.

decision.description: MOS-TRAIN-080's closed set. defer is not terminal, so a candidate may accumulate deferrals and settle once (curation_decisions_settled_uk). There is no default and no absent value: MOS-TRAIN-080 forbids auto-inclusion, so a candidate with no settled decision is backlog, never an implicit include.

reason_code.description: MOS-TRAIN-080's closed set, required when and only when decision is exclude (curation_decisions_reason_ck). MOS-TRAIN-204: reason_code MUST NOT include any value whose meaning is a model outcome -- model_performed_poorly, outlier, hard_case or an equivalent makes the tool non-conformant -- which is why this is an enum here and screened again in medos/medos/training/vocabulary.py for the per-Dataset vocabularies a schema has never seen.

note.description: Reviewer note. MOS-STORE-272 and MOS-API-006: free text that MUST NOT carry PHI. The platform cannot check that, which is why the field is optional and why MOS-TRAIN-079 keeps every structured field of the candidate de-identified rather than relying on reviewer discipline.

review_seconds.description: MOS-TRAIN-080: time on task, the queue's own quality signal. NOT NULL in the column, so required here; a queue whose median decision takes four seconds is a queue nobody read.

allOf.description: curation_decisions_reason_ck as a schema constraint: (decision = exclude) = (reason_code IS NOT NULL). An exclusion without a reason is the mechanism by which a training corpus quietly becomes optimistic (MOS-TRAIN-081, MOS-TRAIN-203).
